Definition: fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man
BiblicalUsage: 1) fatness, fat piece, fertile place, richly prepared food; 1a) fat, fatness, fat pieces; 1b) oil, olive oil; 2) fatness; 2a) stout, vigorous; 2b) fertile spots or places
